newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front page- Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front page- Feb 26.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Wednesday.

WASHINGTON - President Clinton and top aides were intimately involved in orchestrating a broad campaign fund-raising operation during his first term and explicitly authorised the use of the White House as a tool to woo or reward big donors.
WASHINGTON - Since Bill and Hillary Clinton moved into the White House in January, 1993, barely a week went by when they didn't have overnight guests.

WASHINGTON - The Pentagon disclosed that the CIA had warned the Army of the possible presence of chemical weapons at an ammunition depot in southern Iraq in 1991, days before U.S. troops blew up the arsenal.
BALTIMORE - Maryland's campaign to make community service a requirement for a high school diploma has left more than 6,000 students in jeopardy of not graduating this spring.
MEDIA, Pennsylvania - Multimillionaire John du Pont was convicted of murdering an Olympic wrestler, but jurors ruled that he was mentally ill.

CABORCA, Mexico - Miguel Angel Caro Quintero, identified by U.S. officials as one of Mexico's drug smuggling kingpins, says he has no problems leading an ordinary life in this small desert town 60 miles south of the U.S. border.
